title: Cyft decision
description: How one item scored against one profile, and where it was routed. Scores are meaningless without the profile they were computed against.

profile_updated.description: Which version of the profile this was scored against. A profile change invalidates the score.

vetoed_by.description: Veto id, if any. A veto short-circuits scoring; a high score does not survive it.

per_goal.description: One entry per goal the item was scored against. An item can be strong for one goal and irrelevant to another.

effort.description: 5 means cheap. Inverted so every dimension points the same way.

risk.description: 5 means low risk. Inverted for the same reason.

reason.description: Why this route. For reject, name the gate it failed.

measure.description: What a test would measure. Required for test.

promote_when.description: Required for watch. The specific condition that would move it up.

reassign_to.description: Required for not-mine. Which entity or owner it belongs to.

decided_by.description: proposed means the tool drafted it and no person has accepted it yet. Only a human moves an item to act.
